evidence.excerpt: Official corporate menu publishes the current Signature Creations, sundaes, pre-packed favorites, party packs, cakes, petite cakes, cupcakes, cookie sandwiches, pies, shakes, and smoothies, and warns that individual items vary by store.

Current six-page Food Allergies and Sensitivities Reference v.042826, copyright 2026, states that X means the item contains the specified allergen and covers egg, milk, peanuts, sesame, soy, tree nuts, and wheat.
Live official The Perfect Pair page identifies Devil's Food Cake, Cookies 'n' Peanut Butter Ice Cream made with OREO and REESE'S, frosting, and fudge.
Official Create Your Own page publishes 11 always-available flavors, four seasonal flavors, 31 local-favorite flavors, and 29 mix-ins; the page marks seasonal and local favorites as varying by store.
Official FAQ says Cold Stone is not nut-free; manufacturing and on-site preparation may leave peanut/tree-nut traces, and residual gluten or lactose may mix on the frequently cleaned frozen slab.
Official nutrition hub links current ingredient, nutrition, and Food Allergies and Sensitivities documents and directs customers with allergies to the chart.
Targeted web searches corroborated the corporate domain, current menu pages, nutrition hub, FAQ, live promotional pages, and current allergen PDF.
